Each maps to a Test ID in acceptance-tests.md with a named test target. No in-scope requirement is stated only as intent.

REQ-001->AC-001..007, REQ-002->AC-008..011, REQ-003->AC-012..015, REQ-004->AC-016..018, REQ-005->AC-019..020, REQ-006->AC-021..023 (requirements.md Acceptance Criteria; acceptance-tests.md TEST-001..023 table). Every stated Goal has at least one matching AC and every AC traces back to a Goal; no orphaned goal found.

Acceptance criteria specify externally observable outcomes: exact branch-selection + decision-parity comparisons (AC-001..007), 12-named-combination denial/classification outcomes (AC-008..011), schema field values and scenario-id mappings (AC-012..015), byte-unchanged needs: list and step-name enumeration self-checks (AC-016..018), grep-verifiable registration and CI-step presence (AC-019..020), grep-based file-content checks (AC-021..023). None rely on vague intent language.

Non-goals section explicitly excludes editing the 4 R-10-protected suites directly, inventing a Stream-C vocabulary, migrating tests/scenario.tests.sh, treating Stream D as a defect fix, Phase 4/design-sync work, any test.yml human-copy batch beyond the ONE shared batch, and tasks.md/traceability artifacts. Boundaries are concrete file- and behavior-scoped, not generic.

Security Boundaries table names 4 trust boundaries (protected-guard read-only access, inbound-injection fixture handling, test.yml human-copy-only edit path, fixture-vs-real-network isolation). Roles and Permissions and Assumptions sections state explicit human-approval gates (ADR-0010 acceptance, human-copy application) and re-verification obligations (WFI-013 discipline) for shared/mutable state (identity ledger tail, PROTECTED_GATE_SUFFIXES membership).

Risks section ties each named risk to a concrete validation surface already present in the document: the Stream-C-blocker risk to the Stream C status record/AC-012..015, the concurrent test.yml-staging risk to the ONE-shared-batch design (Non-goals/OQ-4) and design.md Global Constraints, the 12-combination matrix risk to AC-008/009/010's explicit per-combination enumeration, and Stream D's step-drop/needs: risk to AC-017's text-marker self-check plus a named human reviewer verification step.

No domain/context-map.md or domain/domain-contract.json is present in the allowed input manifest for this review, and requirements.md carries no Bounded-Context: field; this is test/CI-hardening work with no indication of an Approved domain model gating it. Skip condition (domain/ directory absent or model not Approved) applies.
